items.t: Rough idle right after a cold start
items.job: Diagnose cold-start idle
items.note: Often no repair is needed if it clears within a minute.

items.t: Misfire and rough running from injector deposits
items.job: Replace direct-injection fuel injectors
items.note: Cleaning may help in milder cases. YourMechanic estimates about $2,600 for a 2014.

items.t: Check engine light with code P0315
items.job: Crankshaft position variation relearn

items.t: Oil leak from the oil pressure switch
items.job: Replace oil pressure switch
items.note: Ask about Kia warranty extension WTY026 first.

items.t: Harsh or erratic shifting
items.job: Transmission control software update
items.note: If solenoids are needed, cost is higher.

items.t: Shift quality complaints on the 8-speed
items.job: Transmission software update (service action SA337)
items.note: Free at a Kia dealer if the service action is open on your VIN.

items.t: Ticking from the steering gear when turning
items.job: Steering gear yoke plug repair or gear replacement
items.note: A yoke plug adjustment alone costs far less than a full gear.

items.t: Windshield may detach (recall)
items.job: Windshield inspection and reinstall under recall

items.t: 19-inch wheel may crack (recall)
items.job: Wheel replacement under recall

items.t: Engine compartment fire from ABS module (recall)
items.job: ABS module fuse repair under recall

items.t: ABS module short could start a fire (recall)
items.job: Fuse replacement and software update under recall

items.t: Brake vacuum hose may kink (recall)
items.job: Brake vacuum hose inspection and replacement under recall

items.t: Rear windows work after ignition off (recall)
items.job: Driver door module software update under recall

items.t: A/C not blowing cold
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, receiver/dryer and recharge
items.note: A leak repair and recharge costs much less if the compressor is fine.

items.t: Rattles and creaks from the sunroof
items.job: Sunroof noise repair per bulletin

items.t: Panoramic sunroof slow or noisy when closing
items.job: Panoramic sunroof reset and repair per bulletin
items.note: Motor or track replacement costs more.

items.t: Electronic thermostat replaced under service action
items.job: Electronic thermostat replacement (service action)
items.note: Free if the service action is open. Otherwise YourMechanic estimates about $420-940.

items.t: Airbag warning light on
items.job: Airbag control unit inspection or replacement
items.note: Covered under Kia warranty extension WTY027 for eligible cars; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Low-beam headlight connector failure
items.job: Replace low-beam bulb connector and bulb

items.t: Oil filler cap replaced under emissions campaign
items.job: Oil filler cap inspection or replacement (campaign SC169)
